decision.instructions: Which outcome applies to this request?

method: One synchronous Router request at a time. Each repeat creates a fresh store. Optional/required order alternates each repeat. Individual call latency uses perf_counter_ns; percentiles use nearest rank. Result assertions occur outside timed sections. SQLite uses WAL; optional uses NORMAL (1), required uses FULL (2). Raw timings include Python routing/hooks/key/serialization/store work and the fake predictor. No neural model, tokenizer, HTTP, MCP or GPU; no inference-speed claim. Machine load and filesystem caches are uncontrolled. Temporary databases are removed after each run.
